entities.name: Dragon Stronghold
entities.description: Benthic realm of seawater with magical cold fire at its center, abode of the Scarzam dragons.

entities.name: Scarzam dragons
entities.description: Dragons who dwelt in the Dragon Stronghold.

entities.name: Sivitri Scarzam
entities.description: Learned to harness her magical powers in the Stronghold and rode the sole surviving dragon.

entities.name: Gydolien Mor
entities.description: Summoned the Scarzam dragons to be killed.

entities.name: Chondeah
entities.description: Summoned the Scarzam dragons with Gydolien Mor.

entities.name: Sol'Kanar
entities.description: Killer of the summoned Scarzam dragons.

events.summary: The entire population of Scarzam dragons was summoned by Gydolien Mor and Chondeah to be killed by Sol'Kanar; only the largest, ridden by Sivitri, survived.
